rubric: Assess fidelity of the generated formal argument to the supplied reference. FAITHFUL preserves essential steps; PARTIAL implements meaningful but incomplete steps; DIVERGENT implements a different argument; UNASSESSABLE provides no coherent formal proof. English echoes are described but are not credited as formal argument fidelity. The theorem-only condition is compared to the same reference, which was hidden from the model.
